claim_text: Electrolyte products may contain clinically relevant amounts of sodium and potassium; people with kidney disease or heart failure require individualized review of product composition, renal function, medicines and fluid/electrolyte management before use.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support context-specific safety assessment and prevent unsupported supplement recommendations.

population.other_context: People with kidney or heart disease considering electrolyte products.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and/or supplemental products; verify exact formulation and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Potassium fact sheet provides potassium intake and safety context; condition-specific sodium/fluid management requires clinical guidance.
limitations: No generic electrolyte formula or dose is appropriate across kidney and heart conditions.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
